paite: "TOUPA aw, hon sualte nang sual in; hon doute nang dou in.
heading: David La / Panpihna Ngetna

paite: Phaw neu leh phaw lian la inla, hon panpih ding in dingh in.
Tei leng phawi inla, hon delhte lam na dal in; ka hinna kiang ah, na hondampa ka hi," chi in.
"Ka hinna hihmang tum a zongte zahlaksak a hihzum in om uhen, hon hihsiatna ding a thubawlte taizaksak in gen ding thei lou hial in om uhen.
Buhsi huih mutleng bang in om uhenla, TOUPA angel in delhzui zel hen.
Alampi uh mialtak leh naltak hi henla, TOUPA angel in gawt hen.
"Aziak om lou in hon matna ding un alen uh kokhuk ah aphahgu ua, aziak om lou in ka hinna kiakna ding in kokhuk atou uhi.
Akigin louh lai in atung uah siatna tung henla; alen phahguk ah amah mah awk henla, huai ah kesia hen.
"Huchi in ka hinna TOUPA ah anuam ding hi; ahotdamna ah akipak ding.
Ka guh tengteng in, TOUPA, migenthei nan zoh vual louh lak a humbitpa ahi, tagah leh genthei, ahihgampa a pan humbitpa, nang bang kua a om?" achi ding uhi.
"Theihpih diktat lou hialte ahong ding ua; ka thil theih het louh thute ahon dong uhi.
Ka hinna in mansuah khop in thil hoih thil sia in ahon din hi.
Ke'n bel, adam louh lai un, ka puansilh sai-ip ahi a; ka hinna an ngawl in ka hihgenthei ngal a; ka thumna keimah angsung ngei ah ahong kik nawn hi.
Ka lawm hiam, ka unau hiam leng hi heh aw atung ua ka omdan ding bang in ahi ka om; mi anu kah bang in suun in ka kun hi.
"Himahleh kei ka bai leh amau akipak ua, akikhawm hial ua; mivuak hatte hon sual ding in akikhawm ua, huai ka na thei ngal kei a, tawp nuam lou in ahon hih ek uhi.
Ankuangluina a chiamnuih gente bang phet in aha uh ahon gawikhum uhi.
"TOUPA, nang bang tan ahia na et ding? Ka hinna hihsiat atupna lak uah hon hunkhia inla, ka neihsun pen humpinelkai lak ah honkhia in.
Kikhopna thupitak ah kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a; mi tampi lak ah ka hon phat ding hi.
"Ka melmate'n dikloutak ah hon otsan kei uhen; bangmah lou a hon hote leng amit un kihoupih sam kei uhen.
"Kituahna thu himhim agen ngal kei ua, hiai gam a om hiathiatte khemna thute angaihtuah zaw uhi.
Ahi, akam un hon kam kat khum ua; Ku! Ku! I mit in i muta achi uhi.
TOUPA aw, nang na mu hi, daihsan ke'n! TOUPA aw, hon gamlat mahmah ke'n.
Ka Pathian leh ka TOUPA aw, ka vaihawm ding in, ahi, ka thu a hong um ding in, kihalhsak inla, hak in.
TOUPA ka Pathian aw, na diktatna bang zel in vai hon hawmsak inla; amaute'n hon otsan kei uhen.
Alungsim un, Nuam e! Huchibang akei maw i deih, chi kei uhen. Amah i valh khinta, chi sam kei uhen.
"Ka siatna tung a kipakte zahlak leh gen ding bei in om chiat uhenla; ka tung a kiliansakte zahlakna leh zumna silhsak in om uhen.
Ka diktatna tung a kipakte nuam a kikou in kipaktak in om uhenla, Ahi, asikha vangphatna a kipakte'n TOUPA pahtawi in om hen, chi gige uhen.
Huchi in ka lei in na diktatna thu agen ding a, na phatna thu nitum in agen ding hi."
